summary:
Architectural and UX implementation plan to streamline the Perfusense interface:
- Remove the top black ticker bar above the navbar and adjust layout offsets.
- Relocate the Zone Timers component from the Live Monitor to the dedicated Zones view, replacing existing complex alerts.
- Expand the Live Heatmap to full-width and position the 8-hour posture history chronology directly underneath.
- Simplify the Settings / Hardware view to isolate and showcase the 64-Piezo Cell Topology Map exclusively, removing peripheral diagnostic panels.
- Remove the Settings button from the top navbar while preserving access through the minimized flyout sidebar.
- Eliminate visual clutter, sample stickers, and debug artifacts for a clean, professional clinical workflow.
